name: bond
description: Dev workflow commands, project-flexible: commands resolve a per-repo profile (PR host, base branch, Jira tracker or none, reviewers, drafts) so they work inside Bonliva and outside it. Ships help, chrome-debug, disk-analyze, implement, investigate, jira, open-pr, ship-pr, start; bundles the readable-code-structure, comment-hygiene, testing-behavior, vertical-horizontal-review, pr-template, woodpecker-cli, authorship-conventions, routing-model-and-effort, routing-code-review, context-cost, and finishing-with-code-review skills; ships the DocsExplorer agent, the TestRunner agent and the effort-low…effort-max agents; a SessionStart hook carries the always-on standing rules, and hooks block AI signatures in commits, PRs and docs. Bonliva-only commands and MCP setup live in the bond-bonliva plugin.
